frozen: 2026-11-07, before any run of E1, E2 or E3; its sha256 is recorded before the runs start and checked before scoring. Never edit this file.
context: Three mock TMLR reviews (2026-11-07) asked for (E1) an untouched test of the end-of-study claims under all four error processes, (E2) a drift of the other sign, and (E3) a second standard GP surrogate. All three are post hoc with respect to the paper's procedures and lie outside the paper's Holm families; E1's family is declared here.

common.landscapes: all twenty of the main sweep
common.estimand: deployed design at the final trial, regret as a fraction of opt_z; gain = standard process (best observed rating) noisy regret less the procedure's noisy regret; price = procedure's clean-twin regret less the standard process's clean-twin regret; cost = standard noisy less standard clean; shares are ratios of landscape means (analyse_boba_adaptations' estimand)

intervals.primary: 95% percentile landscape bootstrap, 2,000 resamples, as in the paper
also_reported: t interval over the 20 landscape means
two-way landscape x seed bootstrap (landscapes and seeds resampled independently)

common.test: two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank over the 20 landscape means

E1.question: Do the paper's end-of-study results hold on seeds no analysis has used to choose or score them, under all four error processes?

runs.gaussian: taken from output-boba-confirmatory (the same seeds, already run), so the four processes pool

procedures.standard: best observed rating at the final trial
procedures.LCB1: visited design with the highest posterior mean less one latent SD after all 50 trials (rescore_ship_rules)
procedures.LCB2: the same less two latent SDs; the rule seeds 7-11 chose in both cells
procedures.sitting2: the last 2 of 50 trials re-rate the top 2 visited designs by LCB1 once each, ship the best-rated (replay_end_of_study, rho 1, shared sitting model); cell A
procedures.sitting16: the same with 16 designs; cell B

primary_family.H1: LCB2's gain over the standard process in cell A, four processes pooled, is positive
primary_family.H2: sitting16's gain over the standard process in cell B, four processes pooled, is positive
primary_family.H3: sitting16's gain over LCB1 in cell B, four processes pooled, is positive
primary_family.H4: sitting16's gain over LCB2 in cell B, four processes pooled, is positive
primary_family.expected: all four positive, from the held-out seeds 12-16: H1 about +0.02 to +0.03, H2 about +0.2, H3 about +0.25, H4 about +0.2

secondary_descriptive: sitting2's gain in cell A and its increments over LCB1 and LCB2
control: the new directories' clean twins equal output-boba-confirmatory's, run for run

E2.question: Does the direction of the drift change the cost of error, the selection share or what the end-of-study procedures recover?

runs.pairing: drift_down shares drift's noise seed (sim.error_model_seed_index), so each run pairs with the main sweep's upward-drift run of the same landscape, acquisition, cell and seed and differs only in the ramp's sign

reported: deployed cost of error and final search loss under each direction, and their difference (down less up)
the selection share of the deployed cost under each direction
the gains of LCB1, LCB2 and the sitting (2 in cell A, 16 in cell B) over the standard process under each direction
E2.inference: descriptive sensitivity; landscape-bootstrap intervals and Wilcoxon p of the paired differences, no family-wise correction

E3.question: Do the cost of error, its split into search and selection, and the posterior ship rules depend on the GP surrogate?

runs.gp_prior: legacy: BoTorch's default before 0.12 (scaled Matern-5/2 ARD, Gamma(3, 6) lengthscale and Gamma(2, 0.15) outputscale priors, Gamma(1.1, 0.05) noise prior)
runs.pairing: the same noise streams as the main sweep's runs of the same landscape, acquisition, cell, error model and seed; only the surrogate differs

reported: deployed cost of error (against the arm's own clean twin) and the selection share, beside the default GP's on the same runs
the clean twins' deployed regret under each surrogate
the gains of LCB1, LCB2 and the posterior-mean rule over the standard process within the arm, refitted with the arm's own surrogate, beside the default GP's
E3.not_done: the sittings are not replayed under the legacy prior (replay_end_of_study refits only the default GP)
E3.inference: descriptive sensitivity; landscape-bootstrap intervals and Wilcoxon p, no family-wise correction
